message.content:
The 3D chair viewer displays a chair with a **light pink (or blush) textured fabric upholstery** (appearing as a woven or knitted material) and **light-colored (cream or pale wood-toned) legs**.  

Compared to the original description of “blue fabric and dark legs,” the upholstery color/material has changed (from blue fabric to light pink textured fabric), and the legs’ color/material has also changed (from dark to light-colored).
